rc_codes_after.0: pass - positive/continuity/defaults fidelity held and every negative case was rejected with exactly the declared type name
rc_codes_after.1: harness failure - unusable environment / missing or unparseable evidence file / product import failure (unchanged)
rc_codes_after.2: no verdict - issued BEFORE any case can be judged: the frozen per-case declaration itself is missing/unusable (reason 'cases_json_declared_expectation_missing:<ids>'), or the positive-side fidelity expectation is missing/not matched. verdict='no_verdict'
rc_codes_after.3: a judgement WAS possible and did not hold: nothing raised (FAIL_not_rejected), wrong type (FAIL_wrong_exception_type), import/file error (FAIL_import_or_file_error), or declaration mismatch (FAIL_declared_expectation_mismatch)
